answer: The Meadow Voyage Mechanism requires each identity to submit a unique, unrepeatable proof of physical location during a specified meadow-based journey. Enforcement rules mandate that an attacker must replicate this journey in real-time, incurring a concrete per-identity cost of time, travel, and exposure to environmental risks. This mechanism ensures that sybil identities cannot be created without the attacker expending irreplaceable resources tied to the umber of failed attempts.
